gloss: out of fashion; behind the times

definitions.gloss: out of fashion; outdated; behind the times
definitions.explanation: Something that was once trendy but is no longer in style.

examples.japanese: そのデザインは{流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れだ。
examples.english: That design is out of fashion.

examples.japanese: {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れの{服|ふく}を{着|き}ていると{笑|わら}われる。
examples.english: If you wear outdated clothes, people will laugh at you.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}が{勧|すす}めるファッションは{流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れのことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The fashion that parents recommend is often out of date.

notes:
A compound of {流行|りゅうこう} (trend, fashion) + {遅|おく}れ (delay, falling behind). Used as a noun or as a no-adjective to describe things or people that are behind current trends. Can apply to fashion, technology, ideas, or culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れの{服|ふく}: outdated clothing
- {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れになる: to go out of fashion
- {流行遅|りゅうこうおく}れの{考|かんが}え{方|かた}: outdated way of thinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時代遅|じだいおく}れ: behind the times — broader; emphasizes being out of step with the era, not just fashion
- ダサい: uncool; lame — casual slang; a subjective judgment of style rather than being literally behind trends
- {古臭|ふるくさ}い: old-fashioned; musty — emphasizes something feeling old and stale
